clock.origin: elapsed proper time since each matched zbar=20 initial slice
clock.donor_velocity_conversion: No donor four-velocity consumed; chosen non-tilted IC has n=(1,0,0,0) in x0=ct, U=(c,0,0,0).

cosmology.density_owner: FlatFlrwBackground: rho_crit0=3H0^2/(8*pi*G); mH=mp; mHe=4mp; nH0=(1-XHe)*Ob*rho_crit0/mp; nHe0=XHe*Ob*rho_crit0/(4mp)
cosmology.scope: Rounded Planck-like reference choice, not a joint likelihood sample. Omega_r=9.2e-5 is an explicitly rounded effective radiation fluid; massive-neutrino transition detail is omitted. Physical densities and Lambda fixed across q; H0 labels the zero-shear reference normalization.

background.scope: Stress-free prescribed EoR background conditional on data at zbar20. This family is not an observationally admitted primordial Bianchi cosmology. No continuation to recombination or today is claimed.

gas_initial.rationale: Approximate post-decoupling T proportional to a^-2 initialized using Furlanetto, Oh and Briggs 2006 eq66. Residual H ionization 2e-4 and neutral He are declared approximate freeze-out initial conditions, not exact REC output. No recombination calculation or inferred donor dataset is substituted.
gas_initial.conflict_resolution: Neither 20 K nor archival 6.137 K is imported as a matching donor. The explicit cooling approximation defines baseline; 20 K is a separate early-heating IC sensitivity. The archival 6.137 K belongs to mismatched background/epoch provenance and stays historical.
gas_initial.inventory: Exactly selected 1H/4He aggregate model. D,T,3He,Li omitted from the model, not hidden tracked reservoirs.
gas_initial.normalization: nb=nH+4*nHe; Yi=ni/nb; element fractions use nH or nHe; xe=ne/nH; Ye=ne/nb; electrons excluded from nb

radiation_initial.ionizing_photons: Exactly zero by chosen source-switch-on IC at zbar20; this is an explicit idealized IC, not a missing donor field filled with zero.
radiation_initial.cmb_reference: Isotropic blackbody at a_ref with T=Tcmb0/a_ref; Tcmb0/a later is the isotropic Compton reference approximation, not exact directional temperature.
radiation_initial.scope: No pre-zbar20 astrophysical photons or gas photoheating. Source onset and prehistory uncertainty remain conditional IC assumptions.

source.high_z_support: The analytic function is selected as an explicit phenomenological continuation over 8<zbar<=20. It is not claimed to be measured or calibrated there; model uncertainty is separate from numerical convergence. No tabulated provider is extrapolated.
source.cosmology_conversion: Use published numerical MD14 fit as a chosen comoving source law in the reference cosmology; no claim of re-fitting its observed luminosity dataset to Planck.
source.spectral_model: photon-number shape phi(E) proportional to E^2/expm1(E/(kB_eV*Tstar)), normalized to integral 1 on selected support
source.spectral_choice_source: https://arxiv.org/html/2304.02038v2, discussion following eq3 and eq4; https://arxiv.org/abs/1405.5473
source.spectral_scope: Idealized O-star-like blackbody shape, not a stellar-population synthesis spectrum or empirical EoR spectral fit. Truncation at 100 eV is part of model; report omitted blackbody tail fraction separately.
source.proper_spectral_rate: escaped_total_comoving_rate/(mpc_cm^3*a^3)*phi(E), photons cm^-3 s^-1 eV^-1 integrated over solid angle
source.angular_density: proper_spectral_rate/(4*pi); apply angle weights exactly once when making cell-integrated photon stocks

provider.domain_scope: Operational literal-source formula domain; no empirical percent-accuracy guarantee at very low T. Preserve and output CI-floor, CE-cap and excluded-DR-cooling contributions.
provider.cross_sections: AtomicProvider::reference().cross_section, pinned Verner fit, energy <=50000 eV; use existing fit cutoffs without changing binding thresholds
provider.numerical_scope: Canonical Rust binary64 point implicit integration with empirical refinement. No inherited FT03 root/interval or rigorous continuum certificate.
provider.ownership: Each absorbed photon owns one species event plus binding and heat E-chi. RR/DR and radiative cooling escape once. CI binding is a thermal sink once. Signed Compton transfer has opposing CMB reservoir. Thermal expansion work and photon redshift/boundary work have separate owners.

pre_run_accuracy.Y_response_floor: 1e-7 times each species element/H to baryon normalization; charge-constrained electron floor propagated from ionic floors
pre_run_accuracy.near_zero: Below the response floor or numerical resolution, report unresolved estimate/envelope; no detection, sign or relative-percent claim.
pre_run_accuracy.energy_photon_ledgers: Maintain inherited structural owner checks. New cumulative normalized ledger tolerance 1e-8 using max(total injected+initial energy or count, positive fixed unit floor); report raw dimensional residual too.
pre_run_accuracy.positivity: No clipping or extrapolation. Invalid iterate rejects/backs off; invalid accepted state fails the run.

approximation_diagnostics.radiation_stress: Retain actual ionizing U2. DeltaP_ion=nH*U2*eV_to_erg. delta_s=a^-3 integral a^3*(8piG/(3c^2))*DeltaP dt.
approximation_diagnostics.background_radiation: Estimate omitted stress from free streaming initially isotropic radiation at a_ref in the same metric; use the entire effective Omega_r fluid for a conservative envelope, with CMB subset identified. Ignoring only ionizing stress is insufficient.
approximation_diagnostics.directional_cmb: For local mu, T(mu,a)=Tref/sqrt((1-mu^2)*exp(-2*b)+mu^2*exp(4*b)); integrate T^4 angular moments. The use of isotropic Compton Tref is separately labelled.
approximation_diagnostics.interpretation: Perturbative diagnostic, not rigorous bound. Exceeding target lowers approximation accuracy claim or triggers one targeted feedback decision; never erase the computed histories. Paired numerical resolution does not resolve model error.

source_variant.rationale: Named source-normalization sensitivity to uncertain escaping LyC fraction, not a posterior draw

ic_variant.rationale: Explicit early-heating sensitivity that resolves historical 20 K alternative without pretending it is matching REC data
